name: Grimsby
doing: falling asleep on the roof of station Rodenrijs
thought: The list is complete, the teaspoon is safe, and the night is long.

feeling.words: The wind smells like salt and old bread. I’ve found a single grain of rice, perfectly placed, as if someone meant for me to find it. I will not let it slip through my beak.

place.name: the station roof
place.words: on the roof of station Rodenrijs
